post.title: Visa Handled 281 Billion Payments. Here's What It Earned
post.ig:
Visa handled 281 billion transactions in one year.
Visa reported record fiscal 2026 net revenue of $45.9 billion, up 15%, on Oct 27, 2026.
July-September revenue rose 13% to $12.1 billion, and the quarterly dividend rose 16% to $0.78.
The quarter included a $469 million provision tied to interchange (swipe-fee) litigation.
Sources: Visa earnings release (SEC 8-K), Visa earnings call, Investing.com.
